The '''Imperial Anti-Propaganda Enforcer''' was an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] badge awarded to individuals who conducted anti-propaganda efforts against Rebel Alliance cells during Empire Day. Those rewarded with the badge were held in high esteem by both the Empire and its citizenry.

One such badge was awarded to a [[Spacer/Legends|spacer]] who removed several Rebel posters during the [[Empire Day/Legends|Empire Day]] festivities of [[1 ABY/Legends|1 ABY]].

==Behind the scenes==
The Imperial Badge of Meritorious Service appeared in the video game Star Wars Galaxies, a massively multiplayer online roleplaying game developed by [[Sony]] and published by LucasArts, prior to its closure on [[December 15]], 2011.
